denominator.exclusion: excludes recovery_state == external_library: CRT and Windows library code that the lift calls and never translates (tools/lift_whole_image.py drops these rows by written policy)
denominator.name: lift_scope
denominator.note: every percent_of_lift_scope_bytes in this file is over these bytes

machine_carried.meaning: in-scope bytes whose behaviour is still supplied by machine-derived code rather than recovered source

proven_recovered.meaning: recovered bytes an oracle has executed against the original and found to agree

unproven_recovered.meaning: recovered bytes never executed against the original: declared complete, never demonstrated equivalent
